description: Read one maintenance window with its schedule and its next three occurrences. It has the list_maintenance_windows fields plus next_occurrences, each with start and end. Use it to confirm when a recurring window fires next. To check a schedule before saving it use preview_maintenance_window; to find a window use list_maintenance_windows.

window_id.description: The window's uuid from list_maintenance_windows. An id that is not a window of this organization is a 404.

name: get_maintenance_window
title: Get a maintenance window
